title: Ferritin–CRP coupling adds no reliable cross-cycle hemoglobin prediction beyond conventional iron and CBC measures
abstract: A registered product of standardized log ferritin and log CRP was added to flexible conventional iron, CBC and demographic predictors of hemoglobin in nonpregnant women20–49. Training used NHANES2003–04(n=922); frozen transfer used separately recruited NHANES2005–06(n=998). Weighted MSE decreased0.677043 to0.675608(g/dL)², a0.212% gain; joint source–target survey-PSU bootstrap95% interval for gain was[−0.007054,0.007185]. MAE worsened and source cross-validation mean gain was negative. This feature test does not establish improved physiological inference or clinical utility. Validation is across cycles within one survey, not independent institutions.
